units.text: Aspose.Imaging FOSS for .NET reads and writes raster and vector image formats including JPEG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, PSD, EMF, WMF, and DICOM. It converts images between these formats and inspects their headers to obtain dimensions, bit depth, and frame count without fully decoding the image. The library covers formats in the .NET FOSS ecosystem that lack header-only inspection, such as PSD, EMF, WMF, and DICOM, providing a unified interface for format detection and metadata extraction.
Detects image formats by reading only the file's signature bytes and returning an ImageFormat value, so identifying a file never requires pulling in a full imaging stack.

Reads a format's real header fields directly into an ImageInfo — width, height, bit depth, and frame count — for PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WEBP, ICO, TIFF, PSD, EMF, WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF, as a free open source .NET image manipulation API with no decode step.

Counts real multi-frame and multi-page content where the container format actually carries it: GIF walks its image-descriptor blocks, ICO its directory entries, TIFF its IFD chain, and a bundled multi-page DJVU its FORM:DJVU page components.
Provides both synchronous and async entry points for the same operation — ProbeFile()/ProbeFileAsync() and Probe()/ProbeAsync() — so a probe can run on an ASP.NET request thread without blocking it.

Never throws on a signature match it cannot fully parse — malformed or truncated input comes back as an ImageInfo with only Format set, never an exception, so a probing pipeline can run unattended over untrusted input.
Runs without any external dependencies, making it a lightweight, self-contained imaging library for .NET applications.

Aspose.Imaging FOSS for .NET exposes static methods DetectFormat, Probe, ProbeFile, ProbeAsync, and ProbeFileAsync on the ImageProbe type to inspect image headers and return ImageFormat or ImageInfo values.

It adds full decoding, editing, rendering, and conversion across a much broader format range.
ImageFormat class lists the supported image formats: Avif, Bmp, Dicom, DjVu, Emf, Gif, Heic, Ico, Jpeg, Png, Psd, and Tiff.
ImageInfo class holds read-only properties for an image's Format, Width, Height, BitDepth, and FrameCount, and provides a constructor to create an instance.
ImageProbe class provides methods DetectFormat, Probe, ProbeAsync, ProbeFile, and ProbeFileAsync to inspect image data and return an ImageInfo instance.
